outcome: diagnostic accuracy of color Doppler ultrasound for antenatal diagnosis of morbidly adherent placenta
cohort: 69 pregnant women in their third trimester with a diagnosed placenta previa on ultrasound in their current pregnancy.
finding: This study concluded a higher diagnostic accuracy of color Doppler ultrasound for antenatal diagnosis of morbidly adherent placenta in gravid females having placenta previa.
